         **Review examples:**

            2. _Tessa Wilde_, Sep 20, 2026, 4/5: "amazing app!! I would have given 5 stars, but I'm unable to continue app due to price is way too high."
            3. _Lorna Carroll_, Sep 21, 2026, 5/5: "I'm really pleasantly surprised with this app, I had downloaded it for the free trial calisthenics challenge, fully expecting to cancel and delete it at the end of the trial but I can honestly say I really enjoy the workouts, look forward to doing them and miss it if I've not done a workout. But let's talk about results! I never ever thought I'd see abs on my body, people are commenting on how toned I look (even with the loose skin after 6st weight loss) All in all Im loving the app."
